snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.description: The site serves one active snapshot, with the documentation in Spanish and in English. Import the sources from Git, publish a new one with the published revisions or go back to an earlier one.
snapshots.actionsHint: They run in a separate process, one at a time.
snapshots.hint: Importing updates the sources and their translations (docs/en) with the files of the repository and never touches the revisions. Publishing renders the whole documentation in both languages and activates the result on the site.
snapshots.noJob: No job since the dashboard started.
snapshots.failed: The job failed: check its output.
snapshots.activated: Snapshot #{id} is now the active one: the site serves it from now on.

pending.title: Revisions not yet on the site
pending.noActive: No active snapshot: the site shows no revision until the first publication.
pending.changedAfter: They changed after the active snapshot #{id}: the site does not show these changes until you publish a snapshot.
pending.publishedAfter: They were published after the active snapshot #{id}: the site does not show them until you publish a snapshot.
pending.unreadable: The published revisions could not be read.
pending.allIncluded: The active snapshot #{id} includes every published revision.
pending.archived: revision #{id} archived: the page goes back to Git · {date}

snapshots.retention: The last 5 and the one that was active are kept.
snapshots.caption: Saved snapshots, newest first
snapshots.empty: No snapshots: publish the first one so the site has documentation.
snapshots.byLocale: {es} pages in Spanish and {en} in English

confirm.title: Activate snapshot #{id}?
confirm.text: The public site will serve this snapshot, in both languages, as soon as you confirm. You can go back to the current one from this same list.

publishModal.title: Publish a snapshot
publishModal.text: Renders the guides, the reference and the pages in Spanish and in English with the published revisions over Git, and activates it on the site.
publishModal.noteHint: Optional. What changes in this publication.
